relations.rationale: Arrival timing has no bearing on relative height.
Hugo's arrival time is unrelated to volunteers distributing schedules.
Arrival timing has no bearing on team assignments.
Who took photographs is unrelated to Dev's height compared to crews.
Photography has no bearing on the river's calmness.
Taking photographs is unrelated to team assignments of Hugo and Cleo.
Photography is unrelated to afternoon wind changes.
Ana being slightly older than Dev doesn't establish anything about her age relative to Jude.
A specific age gap between Ana and Dev doesn't directly confirm a general sentiment about age gaps not mattering, though it's consistent with there being age gaps.
Ana being younger than Jude establishes an age gap exists, which is compatible with but doesn't directly support the claim that gaps didn't matter.
General sentiment about age gaps not mattering is unrelated to Dev and Hugo being on different teams.
Cleo being taller than Hugo is consistent with and supports the claim that neither Cleo nor Hugo was as tall as Dev.
Cleo's height relative to Hugo doesn't establish anything about Dev's height relative to other crews.
Relative height between Cleo and Hugo is unrelated to their team assignments.
Dev being taller than both Cleo and Hugo supports the idea that Dev towered over most crews.
Height comparison between Dev, Cleo, and Hugo is unrelated to team assignments.
Dev's height is unrelated to the ease of judging early heats due to current.
Dev's height relative to crews is unrelated to whether Dev and Cleo were on different teams.
Dev's height is unrelated to families watching boats at the finish line.
Dev and Hugo being on different teams doesn't determine whether Hugo and Cleo are on different teams.
